properties.description:
The record that did the work names the finding it answered (`INVALIDATES`, `* -> *`, carrying `note` and `at`), and every surface that quotes a verdict reads it back.

WRITE: `invalidates`. READ: `invalidated_findings`, plus `loop_status.verifications` (per-row `invalidated_by` / `rerun_owed` / a sentence, and a top-level `rerun_owed` summary) and `graph_report` from the same code. The `where-am-i` skill now gathers `Constraint` — where repairs are commonly written up — and calls `invalidated_findings` before quoting any failing verdict.

⭐ THE READER SHIPPED WITH THE EDGE, deliberately. A marker nothing consults is a comment, a failure this project has now found in `enforced`, in `SUPERSEDES` and in `OBSOLETES` itself.

⭐ IT REPORTS AND NEVER JUDGES. The claim says the last RESULT is stale; it never says the check now passes, never touches the target's `status`, and never removes the check from `attention`. `rerun_owed` is three-valued and null means one side is undated so nobody can say.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO: nothing infers staleness. A finding with no claim against it is reported as having none, which is a real answer rather than a silence.
properties.name: A repair can say what it invalidated, and the reader says whether a re-run is owed
